profile.org_note: Family-owned and family-run, with no published leadership page. The two founding brothers (Jalal and Mohammad Farzaneh) and four second-generation Farzanehs (MJ, Ali, Vahid, Hossein) are described as equal owner-partners; land and finance decisions sit with the family. Land development is done in-house and through family affiliates (co-founder Jalal Farzaneh is reported as owner of Shaz Investments, a Norman land developer). Houston is the only named division, led by a division president. The legal entity name is not confirmed; a third-party directory files the company under a slug that reads Home Creations Direct, LLC.
profile.summary: Private, family-owned production builder founded in 1981 by brothers Jalal and Mohammad Farzaneh, based in Moore, Oklahoma; the company calls itself Oklahoma's largest homebuilder and says it delivers more than 500 homes a year and has built over 17,000. It builds in the Oklahoma City metro and Chickasha and, since 2022, in the Houston metro through a Houston division. A conventional for-sale builder that develops much of its own Oklahoma land through family affiliates and builds in other developers' communities in Houston.
